base.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
base.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments.

flags.text: Operating margin expanding: 15.0% (3y avg) vs 12.7% before
Operating leverage: profit compounding faster than sales (+56.5% vs +47.7%, 3y)
Heavy capex underway: CWIP is 32% of fixed assets
Weak cash conversion: only -63% of 5y profit arrived as operating cash
Cash after investing negative in 5 of last 5 years — growth is funded externally

bull: Annual revenue grew 33.2% in FY26 to INR 3,626 crores with OPM expanding to 16%.
Net worth reached INR 4,748 crores in Mar 2026, offering balance sheet backing for capex.
PAT grew 24.2% YoY in FY26 to INR 364 crores, maintaining high operating leverage.
bear: Severe cash drain with FY26 CFO worsening to negative INR 600 crores.
Working capital stretched as debtor days doubled from 74 to 154 days.
Missed FY26 revenue guidance by INR 374 crores against promised INR 4,000 crores minimum.
